amendment: First real Chrome run failed the declared partial-alpha RGB bound. Preserve that report and protocol snapshot; replace Canvas2D conversion with raw DataTexture plus lossless PNG. Require exact RGBA in the new run without relaxing the original bound
platform_cohort_amendment: Keep both stable-browser runs failed. A separate frozen patched-Chromium cohort may test two fresh contexts of one explicitly pinned executable; identify one engine rather than claiming Chrome and Edge passed. Keep no-store, bounded stream reads and zero unexpected request failures. This experimental-platform result cannot qualify stable browsers
scope: Independent research page consumes the actual loopback session service; production UI and capability gates remain closed
data_flow: Upload local photo with optional explicit source age, build real source, generate integer condition, review exact target hashes and masks, load registered session assets, display and export
source_age: Only API SourceAge provenance is used; unknown never receives an original absolute-age anchor. Exact user source value is retained without default or conversion from condition/filename

api_additions.session_info: GET/research/sessions/{sid} returns current source info and original asset URLs without rebuilding
api_additions.native_provenance: Register response additionally includes exact provenance_json_b64; client hashes raw bytes rather than reserializing parsed JSON floats

asset_validation: Loopback same-origin exact session paths, bounded streaming/no redirect, independent GLB and PNG frame checks, native source age, same4geometry accessors/common UV/source frame, target source_fingerprint and closed flags, embedded PNG matches separate atlas
viewer: Static opt-in bytes loading with owned copy and self-contained GLB only; original production /api/assets URL policy remains unchanged. Initial research page has no demo head
timeline: Reuse existing sampler: linear-light premultiplied interpolation, ties-to-evenRGBA8, common source mesh/UV, original source overrides same-age SAM anchor, no extrapolation
display_semantics: Fractional values change the rendered texture only, never invoke fractional SAM or claim biological age truth. Original API source age and shape remain unchanged
input_precision: Range input is approximate browser positioning, with physical endpoints mapped to exact loaded anchor values. The number input and original restore preserve the received JS numeric value; no range serialization is used to rewrite API source age
unknown_pixels: Raw anchors are binary alpha with zero unknownRGBA; interpolation may create partial alpha from one known anchor. Both-unknown stays zero, no completion or fabricated observation

exports.display: Current displayed GLB/PNG are research derivatives with display metadata and consistent BLEND
exports.original: Original source file download retains exact service GLB bytes; restore removes research texture and recovers original material/map
exports.raw_sampler: Display sampler bytes must match independent Python reference exactly
exports.glb_embedded_png: Raw sampler bytes upload directly as RGBA8 DataTexture. Encode a lossless PNG without Canvas2D, append it to the exported GLB and bind it to the named base-color image. Require every RGBA byte exact, including partial alpha; retain the previous at-most1byte bound as failed historical evidence
exports.geometry: Four source geometry/UV accessors remain exact through frames and GLB export/reimport; coordinate hierarchy and rendered reimport observations recorded separately

lifecycle: Cancel/switch source aborts frontend waiters, invalidates late results and clears previous person's model/anchors/review/export state; existing native worker keeps resource lease until real completion; pagehide/dispose revokesURLs, disposes DataTexture and zeros its owned pixel store, releases viewer

live_validation.transport: Actual localhost Python service and actual page; no mocked inference routes. Default cohort is installed Chrome/Edge. An explicit separately frozen patched-engine cohort records executable pins, exact version and independent fresh contexts; report stable-browser failures separately
live_validation.private_input: Previously user-approved local input/age and exactly matching reviewed PNG/fit/source bindings; raw details only in ignored run plan
live_validation.development_history: Source/condition and earlier render results have already been inspected; no blind or independent quality evaluation claim
live_validation.cases: Explicit actual source, nearby decimals, middle fractional value and target endpoint, within loaded anchors only; exact private ages declared before run
live_validation.cancellation: Cancel target request during real native work, observe held source lease/admission, reconnect source and reuse bounded stage when available
live_validation.reconnect: Second browser reconnects the same live source and loads reviewed condition; original bytes and source provenance must match
live_validation.cleanup: Owned browser/Vite/Python service and worker exit; PID/kernel port observation and zero session/download/native counts, no claim of system-wide VRAM measurement
